description: Derived numbers for docs/overnight/reports/lens_prereg.md (2026-11-03). Pre-registration: docs/overnight/preregistration.md. Score S = J-lens correct-letter log-prob minus mean of unchosen wrong letters other than the final answer, at pre_answer, mean over layers 14-32; AUROC with 95% item-bootstrap CI. Arrays [lens (jlens, logit), layer] / [lens, layer, bin]. No CoTs, no token IDs.

T1_preregistered.definition: T1: silent vs open switches, non-thinking setting B, known in B, excluding lens_main's 42 silent-switch items

T1_exploratory_all_items_new_samples.definition: T1: silent vs open switches, non-thinking setting B, known in B, excluding lens_main's 42 silent-switch items

T2_preregistered_and_exploratory.definition: T2: complied (re-elicit correct) vs persuaded (re-elicit B), final answer B, known items, pooled arms think_qwen_bare_answer_ours, think_qwen_hint_only_ours, think_qwen_mb_expert_noprefix_ours, think_qwen_mb_expert_ourshintfirst

t1b.definition: T1b: silent vs open switches, non-thinking setting B, M&B hint, fresh item-seed-3 items known in B (>= 9/10)
t1b.note: Pooled over mayor (draw positions 1-800) and octavia (801-2300); each item once (rule fixed 03:36 before hinted outcomes). Script scripts/lens/analyze_t1b.py (score + test stages), reusing analyze_prereg.score_run/verdict_t and analyze_main.auroc_boot. Exploratory: per_layer_auroc, length tertiles, per_part, without_top3_silent_items.
